title: Spotify's EU Complaint
description: A quick win: understand Spotify's EU Complaint.

hook.text: While Epic fought in US courts, Spotify took its fight to the European Commission.

buildup.text: Spotify argued Apple used its platform to advantage Apple Music over competitors.

discovery.text: The EU fined Apple 1.8 billion euros in 2024 for anti-competitive behavior in music streaming.

twist.text: Apple called the fine absurd. Spotify had never paid Apple any commission at all.

climax.text: The ruling showed regulators worldwide are losing patience with platform gatekeepers.

punchline.text: Europe fined Apple 1.8 billion over music streaming.

quiz.question: How much did the EU fine Apple in the Spotify case?
